method: Unmodified upstream scan.mjs; full employer descriptions assessed by Codex using the Career Ops five-dimension rubric. These are agent-assisted assessments, not output from its API evaluator. Native 1–5 ratings are holistic, not converted from Nextmove match percentages.
refresh: Reviewed trial snapshot. Existing hourly employer checks control availability; changed descriptions require a new Career Ops review. New Career Ops discovery and assessments are not scheduled.

recommendations.rationale: Enterprise wireless/NMS testing, REST APIs, Jenkins and Git align closely. The 8–12-year band fits dated experience. RF equipment, packet analysis and testbed depth need confirmation; this is a staff IC role, not management.

exclusions.reason: Manager role requires 12+ QA years and BI/cloud/AI platform experience; dated experience is about 9.5 years. Senior role requires hands-on AI/ML testing not evidenced.
Mandatory RF/L1, current Wi-Fi technologies and lab-scale expertise are not sufficiently established.
Other discovered roles require deeper cloud/performance/security or data-centre/5G expertise, or advertise a lower experience band.
LabVIEW, NI TestStand and industrial instrumentation gaps.
Manufacturing inspection or chemical QA, rather than software testing.
